name: smartnews_ads-mcp
description: SmartNews Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_client_id.description: Developer app id (numeric client id) of an approved SmartNews Ads developer application.

platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_client_secret.description: The developer app's client secret; access tokens (scope ads-manager) last 24 hours and are re-requested automatically.

platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_smartnews_ads_ad_account_id.description: SmartNews ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/bm/v1/developer_apps/me/ad_accounts: confirms the developer app token and lists the ad accounts linked to it.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Ad accounts associated with the developer app ({ad_account_id, ad_account_name, owner_business_id, roles}); no currency on this record.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns (page/page_size). Budgets are micros of the account currency: budget_micros is daily_budget_amount_micro (1,000,000 = 1 USD or 1 JPY). `status` is configured_status and is not a filter; raw.delivery_status shows serving.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/insights/campaigns?since=date_fromT00:00:00Z&until=date_toT23:59:59Z&fields=... (optionally target_ids=campaign_id): one row per campaign with totals over the range (viewable impressions, clicks, spend in the account currency). Only Ads Manager v2 objects are reported; first 100 campaigns.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} (application/merge-patch+json) {configured_status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}. Resuming restarts spending.
